title: The moving three-point seed gives a strict quartic Legendre and rectangular-packet gain

transfer.optimized_shape_consequence: H_moving(g)<=H_p*(g)-c_*g^4+o(g^4) for some c_*>0 over K1683 rectangles.

scope_guard: The packet transfer is for the K1683 scalar-product rectangular trial near g=0; shape motion prevents claiming an exact optimized quartic constant, and no unrestricted lower bound follows.
